note: The accepted first-kick-goal source a rebuild reconstructs player_achievements from. The extract is gitignored and hand-curated (ISSUE-084 §9.2): place the accepted file at `extract` or point AFLDB_FIRST_KICK_GOAL_CSV at it; its bytes must hash to extract_sha256. Hashes are over CRLF-normalised bytes. A new extract or a manifest change (--assign-ids, a retirement, a rename) is a new source decision and is re-pinned here deliberately.
